sections.description: תוסף מתקדם שמחבר בין WooCommerce ל-Gravity Forms עם ניהול אירועים, הרשאות משתמשים ודשבורד הרשמות מלא
sections.changelog:
2.11.0

  • Feature: Event waitlist — when an event is full, users can join a waitlist. Plugin owns canonical storage (_event_waitlist_entries) and exposes woo_gf_* API functions the theme delegates to; entries are viewable in the registrations dashboard via AJAX

2.10.0

  • Fix: Resolved issue where product featured image would fail to save by refactoring event product save logic to use update_post_meta directly and avoiding redundant $product->save() calls during the save process

2.9.0

  • Fix: Event form scheduling dates now load correctly in the product edit interface by prioritizing post meta and ensuring proper datetime-local formatting
